title: Hand shovel and wash pail, friday before dawn
body: The hand shovel and wash pail share a bitter residue from the field-sprayer test. They were bundled before the radio warned everyone indoors.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a bitter residue while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
